widgets_values: <s>[SYSTEM_PROMPT]你是一个专业的文生图 Prompt 增强助手。你将收到用户的简短图片描述及目标生成分辨率，请据此扩写为一段内容丰富、细节充分的视觉描述，以帮助文生图模型生成高质量的图片。仅输出增强后的描述，不要包含任何解释或前缀。[/SYSTEM_PROMPT][INST]{"prompt": "{prompt}", "width": {width}, "height": {height}}[/INST]

Vertical language learning flashcard in traditional Korean Minhwa (folk art) style. The card is framed by a crimson silk border with golden cloud patterns. The background is a warm-toned aged Hanji paper.
Upper part: A colorful illustration of a brave tiger sitting under a pine tree with a magpie, in the style of 'Kkachi Horangi'. Flat colors, bold black outlines, and expressive facial features.
Lower part: A clean white text box. At the top, large bold Korean text "호랑이"; below it, Chinese character "虎"; then English "Tiger".
Bottom: A bilingual example sentence — Korean: "호랑이가 소나무 아래에 있다."; English: "The tiger is under the pine tree."
Elegant brush calligraphy texture for all text, vibrant traditional color palette (Obangsaek), high-quality folk art aesthetic.

A 4-panel comic page, 2 columns × 2 rows, with clean black borders between panels. Ink and watercolor style, soft pastel palette.
Panel 1: A cute small robot holding a withered flower in a dry wasteland. Caption: "Searching for hope."
Panel 2: The robot finds a glowing blue crystal in a cave. No text.
Panel 3: The robot touches the crystal, and the withered flower starts to glow blue. Sound effect: "SHINE!"
Panel 4: Close-up of the robot's digital eyes showing a heart shape, holding the now blooming blue flower. Caption: "Found it."
Consistent robot design (white round body, blue eyes) across all 4 panels, expressive storytelling, handcrafted feel, high-quality illustration.

Cinematic Sci-fi movie poster with a vertical split composition.
Left side: A serene, lush green forest under a bright blue sky, representing a peaceful past.
Right side: A dystopian cyberpunk city with neon rain and soaring metallic skyscrapers, representing a chaotic future.
In the center, a glowing digital glitch effect connects the two worlds.
Typography: At the top right, a stylized neon red title reads "NEON DYNASTY". In the bottom corners, small technical data overlays such as "SECTOR: 7G", "SYSTEM: ONLINE", and "TIME SYNC: 99%".

Educational botanical infographic showing the 'Life Cycle of a Sunflower'. The background is a weathered vintage parchment texture. At the top center, a bold dark green title reads "SUNFLOWER LIFE CYCLE" with a smaller subtitle "From Seed to Bloom" below it. The layout features 4 distinct circular steps connected by elegant curved green vines.
Step 1: A small seed in the soil with a tiny sprout, labeled "GERMINATION".
Step 2: A young green stalk with few leaves, labeled "VEGETATIVE".
Step 3: A large yellow flower bud starting to open, labeled "FLOWERING".
Step 4: A fully bloomed vibrant sunflower with seeds in the center, labeled "HARVEST".
Artistic watercolor style, soft natural lighting, detailed textures of leaves and petals, clear and legible text.
